title: Sensor calibration for one region
description: Producer: P3. Converts each sensor's active fire cell-days to the common SNPP_VIIRS_EQ scale. Chain: Terra-only MODIS --terra_only_factor--> Terra+Aqua MODIS --monthly_factors[m]--> S-NPP VIIRS; NOAA-20 --noaa20_factor--> S-NPP; NOAA-21 --noaa21_factor--> S-NPP. Factors are learned on fit_years only and validated on test_years.

test_mae.description: Mean absolute error (cell-days) predicting S-NPP from MODIS on test_years

terra_only_factor.description: Terra-only cell-days x this = Terra+Aqua-equivalent cell-days (learned where both fly). Used for Nov 2000-Jun 2002, before monthly_factors.

noaa20_factor.description: NOAA-20 cell-days x this = S-NPP-equivalent (overlap Apr 2018-Oct 2026)

noaa21_factor.description: NOAA-21 cell-days x this = S-NPP-equivalent (overlap Jan 2024-Oct 2026)

monthly_factors.description: Terra+Aqua MODIS -> S-NPP, per calendar month: median over fit_years of (S-NPP / MODIS)

cv.description: Coefficient of variation of the yearly ratios (uncertainty)

fallback.description: True if pooled/parent-region factor was used because data was sparse

test_mape.description: Mean absolute percentage error on test_years (0-1)

raw_step_ratio.description: Naive raw series: mean 2013-2015 / mean 2009-2011 (shows the 2012 jump)

harmonized_step_ratio.description: Same ratio on the harmonized series (should be near 1)

diagnostics.description: Free-form extras from P3, e.g. Aqua-only vs Terra-only factors (afternoon/morning orbit check). Not used by the app.
